title: MachineTemplate
description: JSON schema for netlabctl machine templates

id.description: Machine template identifier (matches template directory name)

name.description: Display name of the machine template

description.description: Markdown description of the device template

drawing.description: Filename of the SVG icon/drawing in the template folder

userdata.description: Optional userdata script template using ${{{ model.var }}} substitution

metadata.description: Optional metadata script template using ${{{ model.var }}} substitution

id.description: SVG element ID representing the port anchor

type.description: Network type (managed, user, tap, socket, etc.)

netdev.description: Optional extra parameters for QEMU netdev

device.description: Optional extra parameters for QEMU device

id.description: SVG element ID representing the status text or indicator

type.description: Type of status element (name or power)

qemu.description: Extra command line parameters passed directly to QEMU
